_comment: Pose-only delivery with a coverage target: the fewest corners this planner can hand over.
`delivery_mode: lean` switches the stroke stage off entirely, so the delivered set is the
chosen poses and nothing else: no connectors, no clearance check between two poses, and no
claim about what the head does between them. That is exactly what v1 delivered - the
difference is only that the selection stops at the acceptance target instead of running
Measured on the real part (upper face, 1.0544 m2): v1 was 102 points at 99.70%. The greedy
curve needs ~28 items to reach 99.0% and ~100 to reach 99.7%, so the tail is where the
points went. Use this profile to see the floor; use the default `path` mode when the motion
between the poses has to be checked.
coverage_target_pct is a SITE setting - change it here rather than passing
--coverage-target on every run, so the file records what this part was accepted against.
